description:
Specification: compare get_document and attach_documents fields across model output, native events/checkpoints, private trace persistence and public ToolStep projections. Identify any actual new audience; distinguish full signed tokens from scoped aliases. Define the new normal Action output {operation, records}, error behavior, trusted active-request requirement, standalone/workflow rejection semantics and alias lifetime through terminal consumption. Explicitly approve removal of blanket selection-metadata absence from private traces/checkpoints; retain public privacy protections. Creating this epic is not that approval.
Files: inspect agent/request_effects.ex, tools/data_source/attach_documents.ex, stream_events.ex, factory.ex, executor.ex, opaque_aliases.ex, contracts/tool_step.ex and related tests. Record decisions in this issue; update docs/services/agent.md only with implementation.
Tests before implementation: classify existing assertions as behavior, privacy policy or internal-state coupling; specify replacement assertions, including missing/foreign aliases and trusted-context rejection. Do not change expectations without explicit approval.
Action reuse: audit existing GetDocument/Jido.Exec, Record authorization, OpaqueAliases schema projection and StreamEvents completion deduplication. Choose extension/local-only adaptation, no new operation.
Mocking: none; read code and test contracts.
Acceptance: concrete field/audience matrix, exact approved test-contract delta, verified alias scope/lifetime and ordering, named approving human and evidence recorded. Only this gate is initially unblocked.

Required policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/testing-approach.md; documentation edits additionally follow docs/documentation.md. No implementation authorized yet.

comments.text:
Implementation started at Jad's request on 2026-10-31; source baseline remains 32a2c1edb and working tree clean. No commit/push authorization inferred.

Discovery for privacy gate:
- get_document and attach_documents already share Factory.after_tool_call -> OpaqueAliases.alias_tool_result -> RecordResultTransformer. IDs/names/paths and permission projections already travel in ordinary private tool results; full provenance/materialization values become scoped prov_/mat_ aliases.
- Current attachment StateOp effects retain full Records outside that aliased output; this extra payload is introduced by RequestEffects itself. Remove it rather than forwarding raw effects.
- Native trace/thread/checkpoint consumers see normal aliased tool results. Public ToolStep.project is an explicit allowlist (id/kind/name/label/sequence/state/duration), independent of private trace fields. StreamEvents already records private arguments/results and suppresses duplicate completion IDs.
- Existing runner uses Task.async_stream(ordered: true) and emits transformed completion results in pending/declaration order (deps/jido_ai/lib/jido_ai/reasoning/react/runner.ex, run_tool_round).
- Alias scope is server_id, set in ServerManager.spawn_agent_server and cleared on runtime DOWN/forced retirement. Executor knows canonical server_id and must pass it explicitly to StreamEvents (not rely on server_ref, which may be PID). Expand completion outputs before json_safe; if scope was cleared or foreign, fail closed and return no final attachments.
- Trusted request requirement can use native context.request_id and context.state.requests[id] pending status instead of a custom request_effects map; native state is supplied by runner, not model params. Verify with real runtime test before relying on this guard.

Proposed test-contract delta requiring explicit human approval under docs/testing-approach.md:
1. attachment_selection_test: change assertions banning document IDs/provenance references from authorized private trace/thread/checkpoint evidence to parity with get_document; retain public ToolStep exclusion and no raw effect-envelope assertions.
2. attachment_agent_journey_test: keep visible-step/history projections private; distinguish restricted user history from privileged stored traces instead of blanket absence.
3. Retarget RequestEffects state/snapshot/lifecycle tests to StreamEvents observable accumulation and native request isolation; remove tests solely for deleted generic handler machinery, preserving supported behaviors and native StateOp characterization separately.
4. Restore normal native checkpoint availability for agents with attach_documents enabled.

Async approval question sent to Jad with old/new privacy contract. Await explicit response before changing affected expectations or dependent implementation. Epic creation/start request is not being treated as approval of this test-policy delta. No code edited.

Action reuse: extend AttachDocuments/GetDocument/Jido.Exec/Record/OpaqueAliases/StreamEvents/ToolStep, local-only schema output adaptation, no new Action/state store. Errors must atomically reject a whole instruction and prevent delivery; selection instructions cannot materialize or send files. Existing configured/default Pipeline scope unchanged.

Jad explicitly approved the proposed existing-test/privacy contract in chat on 2026-10-31 (reply: Approved). This covers normal authorized private trace/checkpoint metadata parity with get_document, preservation of public ToolStep privacy, and replacement of RequestEffects state/mailbox tests with observable lifecycle tests. Discovery field/audience matrix and alias/ordering analysis are recorded above. Implementation is now authorized; no commit/push permission inferred.
